title: tote stack boxes
text: tote stack boxes. These are not as sturdy as we were hoping.. and one of the lids were destroyed when it arrived... Amazon is great on that part... We purchased these to put things in and STACK.  So you want them to be tough.  They "look" in the pictures like they will be sturdy, but in person, not so much.  The plastic is brittle.  So that is not a good sign.  I will update my review as our use continues.
